meta.title: Meta Tags
meta.intro: Configure the meta tags below. Use tokens to avoid redundant meta data and search engine penalization.

og.title: Open Graph
og.description: Controls how Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn and other social networks interpret this page's content.

description.label: Description
description.hint: Up to 160 characters. Used by search engines in result snippets.

abstract.label: Summary
abstract.hint: Preferably 150 characters or less. Abstract/summary of the page.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.hint: A comma-separated list of keywords about the page.

og_determiner.label: Determine
og_determiner.hint: The word that appears before the content's title in a sentence.

og_site_name.label: Site name
og_site_name.hint: A human-readable name for the site, eg. IMDB.

og_type.label: Content type
og_type.hint: The type of the content, e.g. movie.

og_url.label: Page URL
og_url.hint: Preferred page location or URL to help eliminate duplicate content for search engines.

og_title.label: Title
og_title.hint: The title of the content, e.g. The Rock.

og_description.label: Description
og_description.hint: A one to two sentence description of the content.

og_image.label: Picture
og_image.hint: URL of an image ≥ 200×200 px (recommended 600×316). PNG, JPEG or GIF.

og_video.label: Video URL
og_video.hint: URL of a video that represents the content (recommended ≥ 600×316).

og_image_url.label: Image URL
og_image_url.hint: Alternative version of og:image. Only one needs to be used.

og_video_secure_url.label: Video Secure URL
og_video_secure_url.hint: Secure (HTTPS) URL of the og:video. Non-HTTPS values will be coerced to HTTPS.

og_video_type.label: Video type
og_video_type.hint: Should be video/episode, video/movie, video/other or video/tv_show.

og_image_alt.label: Image 'everything'
og_image_alt.hint: A description of what is in the image (like alt text).

og_locale.label: Location
og_locale.hint: The locale tag, in the format language_TERRITORY. Default is en_US.

og_locale_alternate.label: Alternative locations
og_locale_alternate.hint: Other locales this content is available in, e.g. fr_FR. Multiple values separated by comma.

article_author.label: Article author
article_author.hint: Link to an article author's Facebook profile.

article_publisher.label: Article publisher
article_publisher.hint: Link to a publisher's Facebook page.

article_section.label: Article section
article_section.hint: The primary section of this website the content belongs to.

article_tag.label: Article tag(s)
article_tag.hint: Appropriate keywords for this content. Multiple values separated by comma.

book_author.label: Book author
book_author.hint: Link to a book author's Facebook profile.

book_release_date.label: Release Date
book_release_date.hint: The date the book was released.

book_tag.label: Book tag(s)
book_tag.hint: Appropriate keywords for this content. Multiple values separated by comma.

og_audio.label: Audio URL
og_audio.hint: URL to an audio file that complements this object.

og_audio_secure_url.label: Audio secure URL
og_audio_secure_url.hint: Secure (HTTPS) URL to an audio file. Non-HTTPS values will be coerced to HTTPS.

og_audio_type.label: Audio type
og_audio_type.hint: The MIME type of the audio file, e.g. application/mp3.

profile_first_name.label: First name
profile_first_name.hint: The first name of the person whose profile page this is.

profile_gender.label: Sex
profile_gender.hint: Any of Facebook's gender values. Initial two: 'male' and 'female'.

profile_username.label: Internal name
profile_username.hint: A pseudonym / alias of this person.

video_actor.label: Actor(s)
video_actor.hint: Links to the Facebook profiles for actor(s) that appear in the video. Multiple separated by comma.

video_actor_role.label: Actor's role
video_actor_role.hint: The roles of the actor(s). Multiple separated by comma.

video_director.label: Director(s)
video_director.hint: Links to the Facebook profiles for director(s) that worked on the video.

video_release_date.label: Release date
video_release_date.hint: The date the video was released.

video_series.label: Series
video_series.hint: The TV show this series belongs to.

video_tag.label: Take words
video_tag.hint: Tag words associated with this video. Multiple separated by comma.

video_writer.label: Scriptwriter(s)
video_writer.hint: Links to the Facebook profiles for scriptwriter(s) for the video.
